value.rationale: This is a complete structural classification on the canonical height-rotation fixed locus of the petal move graph, not an arbitrary parameter slice or one-word example. It proves an all-length obstruction and exactly phi(N)-2 locally trapped classes at every odd size, clarifies the mechanism behind petal move rigidity, and bounds the reach of the original hard-unknot census. It explicitly does not mistake local rigidity for nonminimal knot representation.
